newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 349,300 metric tons (MT) equaled the previous week and were one-half above the 4-week average. Major increases were recorded for Japan (80,900 MT), unknown destinations (40,800 MT), Yemen (40,000 MT), the Philippines (31,000 MT), and Thailand (20,000 MT).

Exports of 475,200 MT were one-third over the week earlier and 5 percent more than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were South Korea (78,600 MT), Pakistan (74,600 MT), Taiwan (69,100 MT), Japan (49,600 MT), Colombia (26,500 MT), and Nigeria (24,200 MT).
